item.title: ‘Diplomatic embarrassment’: Hours before tariff ruling,Trump team sought delay - what they told court
item.description: A US court has ruled against Donald Trump's global tariffs. The court stated that the President lacked the authority to impose such duties. This decision invalidates tariffs on China, Canada, and Mexico. Cabinet secretaries had warned of diplomatic consequences. They urged the court to delay its ruling. The administration may appeal to the Supreme Court.

item.title: ‘No power to impose’: US court declares most tariffs illegal; Trump says 'total disaster for country'
item.description: A US federal appeals court has ruled that most tariffs imposed by President Trump under emergency powers were illegal, challenging the core of his trade policy. The court stated that the President exceeded his authority under the International Emergency Economic Powers Act (IEEPA) as the law does not explicitly grant the power to impose tariffs.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: US issues travel warning to China: ‘Enhanced precautions’ urged amid disease spread; Beijing revives COVID-era measures
item.description: A health alert is issued for Guangdong, China. The reason is a rise in chikungunya cases. The CDC advises precautions for travellers. Foshan is the outbreak's epicentre. Chikungunya spreads via mosquitoes. It causes joint pain. Travellers should use insect repellent. They should also wear protective clothing. Vaccines are available in the US. High-risk individuals should be cautious.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Minneapolis gunman killed 2 children after breakup? Inside shooter’s final days
item.description: Robin Westman, 28, fatally shot two children and injured 18 others at Annunciation Catholic Church in Minneapolis before taking his own life. Police cite a recent breakup and increasing isolation as potential factors in the attack.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: ‘US brand globally is in toilet’: Sullivan says Trump’s trade war is pushing India toward China
item.description: Jake Sullivan criticizes Donald Trump's trade policies towards India, asserting they jeopardize the strategic partnership built to counter China. The recent 50% tariff on Indian exports risks pushing India closer to Beijing, as New Delhi seeks to hedge against perceived American unreliability. Sullivan argues Trump's actions undermine US credibility and hand China a diplomatic advantage.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Iowa senator Joni Ernst won’t seek reelection: Democrats eye flipping majority in midterm - reports
item.description: Iowa Senator Joni Ernst will not seek reelection in 2026, paving the way for a competitive open-seat race. Representative Ashley Hinson is expected to contend for the Republican nomination. Democrats, aiming to regain Senate control, have a crowded primary field including Josh Turek, Zach Wahls, Nathan Sage, and Jackie Norris, hoping to capitalize on recent state wins.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: A joke that turned serious: Rubio exits USAID role; hands shutdown to Vought
item.description: Marco Rubio is stepping down from overseeing USAID, passing responsibilities to Russ Vought as the agency nears shutdown. Under Trump, USAID has been dismantled, with programs cut and functions absorbed by the State Department. Trump is also using a "pocket rescission" to allow allocated funds to expire, further reducing US spending on foreign aid.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: JD Vance meltdown over Politico story: ‘Deep state laundering garbage into the conversation’; MAGA rallies behind
item.description: JD Vance has strongly criticized a Politico report questioning Steve Witkoff's role in Russia-Ukraine talks, labeling it a "foreign influence operation." Vance defended Witkoff's progress in negotiations, highlighting narrowed issues like security guarantees and territorial concessions. The controversy has sparked online abuse targeting the Politico reporter, raising concerns about backchannel diplomacy efforts.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: US govt to halt? Trump escalates foreign aid fight - Schumer threatens fall shutdown
item.description: President Trump's unilateral cancellation of $4.9 billion in foreign aid has ignited a firestorm of criticism from both Republicans and Democrats, with Senator Collins deeming the move unlawful. Schumer warned of a potential government shutdown this fall, threatening a standoff in upcoming federal funding negotiations if the rescission isn't reversed.

item.title: Gold prices surge across Egypt after surprise 2% interest rate cut: See what each Karat costs now
item.description: Gold prices in Egypt rose sharply on August 29, 2025, with 21-karat gold hitting EGP 4,650, following a 2% interest rate cut by the Central Bank. The move, aimed at boosting economic activity, coincides with global gold gains amid a weaker dollar. Lower rates typically drive gold demand, especially as inflation eases and local GDP growth improves.

item.title: What's fueling recent tension between Ukraine and Hungary?
item.description: Recent Ukrainian drone strikes on the Druzhba pipeline, which disrupted Hungary's Russian oil supply, have escalated tensions between Budapest and Kyiv. Hungary condemned the attacks, with Prime Minister Viktor Orban enlisting Donald Trump's support, while Ukraine's President Zelenskyy dismissed claims of intentional targeting. Hungary's dependence on Russian oil and its veto of Ukraine's EU accession talks further strain relations.

item.title: Minneapolis shooter 'obsessed' with killing children
item.description: A 23-year-old shooter, once a student, opened fire at Annunciation Catholic School in Minneapolis, killing two children and wounding fifteen others, along with three parishioners. FBI Director Kash Patel labeled the attack as domestic terrorism fueled by hate, citing anti-Catholic rhetoric and threats against former President Trump.

item.title: Bangladesh EC terms upcoming polls 'most risky' in history, warns of unpredictable challenges
item.description: Bangladesh's Election Commission anticipates the upcoming national election to be the riskiest in its history, urging officials to prepare for unforeseen challenges amidst political instability. The election roadmap has received mixed reactions, with some parties welcoming it while others express reservations.

item.title: US senators arrive in Taiwan amid tensions with China
item.description: A US Senate delegation visited Taiwan to reaffirm the partnership and security agreement amid trade deal pursuits with the US by both Taiwan and China. Senator Wicker emphasized continued support through the National Defense Authorization Act and addressed concerns about US commitment under a potential Trump administration. China has voiced strong opposition to the growing ties between Washington and Taipei.

item.title: Sikh man shot dead in LA: What prompted cops to take deadly action; was 'screaming and swinging at cars'
item.description: A LAPD police video revealed the fatal shooting of Gurpreet Singh, a 35-year-old Sikh man, after 911 calls reported him wielding a machete and threatening people. Singh, seen performing Gatka, charged at officers after a car chase, leading to the shooting. The incident is under investigation, with reviews to determine if the use of force was justified.
